blocks.text: A reference is `[registry[:port]/][namespace/]repo[:tag|@digest]`; the first component is a registry host only if it contains `.` or `:` or is `localhost`, otherwise it's a Docker Hub namespace.

$ docker tag rag-api:dev ghcr.io/acme/rag-api:1.4.2    # new name, same image ID
$ echo "$TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io -u acme --password-stdin
$ docker push ghcr.io/acme/rag-api:1.4.2               # uploads only missing layers

items: Repository names must be lowercase; tags are ≤128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_.-] and can't start with `.` or `-`.
`docker rmi` of one tag removes only that name until the last reference goes.
Credentials sit base64-encoded in ~/.docker/config.json unless a credential helper is set; base64 isn't encryption.
Docker Hub rate-limits pulls (lower for anonymous); CI fleets need auth, a pull-through cache, or mirrored bases.

blocks.text: Q: "What's your tagging strategy?" A: "Every build pushes an immutable git-SHA tag; releases add a semver tag and optionally moving tags like 1.4 or latest. Deployments reference the SHA tag or digest, never latest."

items: No dot/colon/localhost in the first part → Docker Hub.
Authenticate or mirror to avoid Hub rate limits.
